Root cause: the `A`/`a` tokens in `src/plugin/customParseFormat/index.js` hardcoded English (`/[AP]M/`, `/[ap]m/`, `input === 'PM'`), so any locale-specific meridiem (zh-cn 上午/下午, ja 午前/午後, ko 오전/오후, br a.m./g.m.) never matched and the parse produced an Invalid Date.
